record.paper_title: Results and open problems in matchings in regular graphs
record.original_question: Let G_{bi,mult}(2n,r) be the class of bipartite r-regular multigraphs on 2n vertices and let lambda(k,n,r) be the minimum, over that class, of the number of k-matchings. Is the lower matching conjecture true, namely that for every k = 1,...,n, lambda(k,n,r) is at least binom(n,k)^2 times ((nr-k)/nr)^(rn-k) times (kr/n)^k?

evidence.quote: The lower matching conjecture, abbreviated here as LMC, states [23] λ(k, n, r) ≥ (n choose k)^2((nr − k)/nr)^(rn−k)(kr/n)^k for k = 1, . . . , n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{bi,mult}}(2n,r)$ denote the class of bipartite $r$-regular multigraphs on $2n$ vertices (with two color classes of size $n$ each, parallel edges allowed). For a graph $G$ and integer $k\ge 0$, let $m_k(G)$ be the number of matchings of $G$ of size $k$ (i.e., sets of $k$ pairwise vertex-disjoint edges). Define
$$\lambda(k,n,r) := \min_{G\in\mathcal{G}_{\mathrm{bi,mult}}(2n,r)} m_k(G).$$
Prove or disprove: for every integers $n\ge 1$, $r\ge 1$, and every $k\in\{1,2,\ldots,n\}$,
$$\lambda(k,n,r) \;\ge\; \binom{n}{k}^{\!2}\left(\frac{nr-k}{nr}\right)^{\!rn-k}\!\left(\frac{kr}{n}\right)^{\!k}.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The Lower Matching Conjecture of Friedland (for bipartite r-regular (multi)graphs) was proved by Péter Csikvári in "Lower matching conjecture, and a new proof of Schrijver's and Gurvits's theorems" (arXiv:1406.0766, 2014; published in J. Eur. Math. Soc., 2017). Csikvári proves a slightly stronger statement using local weak (Benjamini–Schramm) convergence, statistical physics, and graph covers.

status_evidence.title: Lower matching conjecture, and a new proof of Schrijver's and Gurvits's theorems
status_evidence.snippet: We prove Friedland's Lower Matching Conjecture for d-regular bipartite graphs, and in fact a slightly stronger statement.
status_evidence.claim: Csikvári proves the Lower Matching Conjecture for d-regular bipartite graphs.

status_evidence.title: EMS Press – JEMS article
status_evidence.snippet: Published version (2017) of Csikvári's proof of the Lower Matching Conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: The proof appeared in the Journal of the European Mathematical Society in 2017.
